script.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The takeout-menu joke does not match Paul's point about receiving the gospel by revelation. A recipe having a source does not make the comparison work.
The passage does not say Paul later joined the church and taught its people. It also does not give his reason for stating his past plainly.
Paul's zeal for his fathers' traditions does not establish that he was unsure about nothing at all.
Saying Paul started out against the church adds a detail about his beginnings that the passage does not give.
The joke adds a glow to the revelation, which the passage does not mention.
The Kevin Hart line puts down a real person and changes the action from consulting people to telling them news.
One region after another implies an order of travel that Paul does not give.
The oven and drawer comparison does not make sense: Papa did not spend his life in an oven, and years in a drawer are not the same as a lifetime there.
The explanation repeats that the places are not in Paul's list without adding personality or a meaningful distinction.
Being personally unknown does not establish that they did not know his face. Famous on paper also implies a written account that the passage does not mention.
The report says Paul was preaching the faith; it does not say whether he was wavering about it.
